title: nixos/frigate: Add preCheckConfig
reason: Real new mkOption 'preCheckConfig' added, matching the coordinator's flagged title.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: NEW GAP INSTANCE, SAME SHAPE AS EVCC (this batch): total non-discovery both sides, with a striking symptom -- discovered_options instead returns 3 entries (ffmpeg.inputs / .path / .roles) belonging to an unrelated, deeply-nested submodule elsewhere in the file, not the real top-level options. Root cause confirmed: the module declares `options.services.frigate = with types; { ... };` -- another instance of the options-value-wrapped-in-`with` shape. 4th confirmed instance of this recurring gap this round (nvidia-container-toolkit x2, evcc, now frigate).
